patch_description: Revert to the superior CZ-based chain architecture from the second prior program (which achieved 0.72 score with 14 parameters) but add a shared RX prepend layer. This combines the proven RY→RZ→CZ→RZ pattern with a global RX rotation to provide cross-axis expressivity. The RX layer adds only 1 new parameter (rx_shared) while maintaining parameter economy. The X-axis rotation operates in a complementary plane to the existing RY and RZ rotations, potentially improving the circuit's ability to explore the solution space. This hybrid approach balances expressivity with parameter efficiency while reverting from the less effective XX chain to the working CZ backbone.
